## Skill and result

Describe what the skill makes, when to use it and the Subclip test result. Include a preview or sample when possible.

## Source and license

Original GitHub link, author, license and what changed. For original skills, say so. Explain any scanner exceptions.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and its full PR checklist.
- [ ] The source allows changes and commercial use; original LICENSE and credit are retained.
- [ ] Tool names and media context, serial edits, generator choice and credit rules are correct.
- [ ] Listing metadata, cover and optional preview meet the limits.
- [ ] I described the real Subclip test and any remaining limitations.
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run check`, `npm run scan` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] Generated files are included; no secrets, hidden instructions, em dash or middle dot remain.
